skill_card.name: Test Design Generator
skill_card.description: Transforms structured requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, validation rules, and optional API contracts into comprehensive, traceable test designs with positive, negative, boundary, validation, and contract test coverage.

tasks.name: Interpret requirements into testable units
tasks.description: Reads user stories, acceptance criteria, validation rules, and optional API contracts to identify testable behaviors and constraints.
tasks.input_schema: Requirement model, validation rules, optional API contract specification.
tasks.output_schema: Structured requirement-to-test decomposition with coverage guidance.

tasks.name: Generate test case categories
tasks.description: Produces positive, negative, boundary, validation, and contract tests with deterministic identifiers and explicit traceability links.
tasks.output_schema: Structured test case set including traceability links and coverage metadata.

tasks.name: Report incomplete or invalid input
tasks.description: Identifies missing business rules, incomplete validation details, or malformed specifications and returns a structured error object rather than guessing.
tasks.output_schema: Structured error object or gaps report describing missing coverage or invalid input.

documentation.changelog: Initial verified release based on the test design generator skill documentation, metadata, and execution contract details.
